in_hebrew.name: פרנציקוס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'penyah' meaning 'rejoicing' or 'to be joyful'. The 'k' in Franciskus may be derived from the Hebrew letter 'kaph', which has a similar sound.

in_greek.name: Φραντσίσκος
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'phrontis' meaning 'mind' or 'intelligence'. The name Franciskus may be derived from this Greek root, implying a free man of great intellect.

in_latin.name: Franciscus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'francus' meaning 'free'. The name Franciskus may have been adopted by the early Christian Church due to its association with freedom in Christ.
